name: deckhand
description: Automates the repetitive, tedious, indispensable chores of a development workflow. Each plugin is a self-contained unit.

plugins.name: release-please
plugins.description: Configure a google/release-please semantic auto-release pipeline for any GitHub repo: survey the repo, generate the config, walk you through the required permission switch, verify the first run.

plugins.name: appimage
plugins.description: Install a .AppImage as a first-class desktop citizen: /opt binary, hicolor icons, validated .desktop entry, GNOME Activities search, URL schemes. Covers install, upgrade, uninstall.
